ns2:section.sectionText: A course built around a weekend field trip to Baraboo, Wisconsin, for Sustainability LLC residents that investigates the ecology, geology and sustainability of the region. Activities will include tours of forests and wetlands, visits to the Leopold Center and the International Crane Foundation, and a geological hike. Lodgings at Durward's Glen Retreat and Conference Center. The trip takes place Sept 23 - 25. Grading will be S/U. The SLLC is subsidizing costs. Attendance at weekly class meetings before and after the trip required.
